entities.summary: Carolina Valencia Hernández is a female weightlifter from Mexico. She won the gold medal at the 2007 Pan American Games for her native North American country in the − 48 kg weight division. Carolina Valencia was a athletes & competitors from Chetumal (b. 1985-02-08, Chetumal). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
